verdict.rationale: Vanta documents in-product AI that works from customer data. Vanta AI reviews evidence, flags gaps and suggests fixes (vanta-docs-34, vanta-docs-10), and the Vanta AI Agent drafts policies, completes questionnaires and flags issues before they escalate (vanta-docs-15). The pricing page lists agentic search and asking questions across policies, controls, frameworks, tests and documents (vanta-docs-70), and risk scenarios come with suggested control mappings (vanta-docs-87). Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of how the AI insights work (the evidence is mostly marketing copy), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the quality of the suggestions.
